Web security protects the entire exposed application surface

text: Explain that the Equifax breach was not caused by a lack of security tools. The organization had a patching process, but a complex legacy environment and failed verification left an internet-facing portal exposed. Official sources: https://oversight.house.gov/report/committee-releases-report-revealing-new-information-on-equifax-data-breach/ and https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2019/07/equifax-pay-575-million-part-settlement-ftc-cfpb-states-related-2017-data-breach
Source: FYP defense report, literature review and comparison table, pp. 5–10.
textPreview: Source: FYP defense report, literature review and comparison table, pp. 5–10.

text: The workflow at the top shows the steps a tester normally performs. The table compares conventional tools, AI pentesting agents and AI security frameworks. Conventional tools are mature but fragmented. AI systems add reasoning, yet many depend on external models and do not provide broad, continuous reconnaissance or persistent cross-stage correlation.
The operational security gap is orchestration at scale
textPreview: The operational security gap is orchestration at scale

text: Practical limitations prevent current tools from covering large infrastructures as one connected assessment.
textPreview: Practical limitations prevent current tools from covering large infrastructures as one connected assessment.

text:
Specialized tools emit isolated outputs.

Humans repeatedly copy, filter, correlate and decide what to run next.

Assets, services, endpoints and evidence are easily disconnected.

text:
Real infrastructures are wider than bounded CTF tasks.

Each new domain, host, port or endpoint creates more work.

Many AI systems are not optimized for continuous, broad reconnaissance coverage.

text:
API cost, rate limits, connectivity and model behavior can interrupt assessments.

Known pentesting steps do not require expensive reasoning every time.

When the model stops, the core workflow should not stop.

text: Trust and control must span the entire workflow
textPreview: Trust and control must span the entire workflow

text: Use the phrase operational security gap. The central argument is not that the industry lacks scanners; it lacks a dependable harness that can coordinate them over a changing, wide attack surface while keeping evidence and scope intact. Emphasize that LLMs are valuable but should not be mandatory for routine methodology.
Develop one unified harness covering reconnaissance, progressive attack-surface discovery, scanning, vulnerability identification, business-logic analysis, correlation and reporting.
textPreview: Develop one unified harness covering reconnaissance, progressive attack-surface discovery, scanning, vulnerability identification, busine...

text: Use LLM reasoning when available while maintaining a deterministic rule-based mode with no mandatory LLM dependency.
textPreview: Use LLM reasoning when available while maintaining a deterministic rule-based mode with no mandatory LLM dependency.

text: Enforce the authorized scope, validate findings with evidence and require human approval before potentially impactful actions.
textPreview: Enforce the authorized scope, validate findings with evidence and require human approval before potentially impactful actions.

text: The proposed framework combines one unified harness, reliable non-LLM operation and controlled AI assistance.
textPreview: The proposed framework combines one unified harness, reliable non-LLM operation and controlled AI assistance.

text: Source: FYP defense report, Objectives, p. 14.
textPreview: Source: FYP defense report, Objectives, p. 14.

text: State the three formal objectives at a high level. The first objective creates one unified assessment harness. The second keeps the system functional without an external LLM. The third covers scope, evidence and human approval.
Select a question during the presentation to open its explanation.

alt: Proposed architecture diagram showing the commander, shared memory, phase agents, reasoning loop, deterministic pipeline and skills

text: This is the proposed architecture. The central idea is a world model: every tool observation updates shared memory, specialized agents act on that state, and both deterministic and reasoning-driven execution use the same tools and evidence. Use the three buttons for optional explanations, then return here.
Collect signals from tools, targets and prior evidence.
textPreview: Collect signals from tools, targets and prior evidence.

textPreview: Preserve assets, observations, relationships and source evidence.

textPreview: Explain what the evidence may mean and what could be vulnerable.

text: Choose the next useful probe and run the appropriate security tool.
textPreview: Choose the next useful probe and run the appropriate security tool.

text: Compare outcomes, reproduce the result and separate a lead from verified evidence.
textPreview: Compare outcomes, reproduce the result and separate a lead from verified evidence.

text: Record what changed, connect the evidence and revise what should be tested next.
textPreview: Record what changed, connect the evidence and revise what should be tested next.

text: Updated memory changes what the tester observes and tests next.
textPreview: Updated memory changes what the tester observes and tests next.

text: The assessment is a continuous evidence loop—not a one-time scanner run.
textPreview: The assessment is a continuous evidence loop—not a one-time scanner run.

text: A real pentester continuously observes, stores evidence, forms a hypothesis, tests it, validates the result and updates memory. That updated state changes the next decision. This loop is the world model that connects the architecture.
Specialized agents for each testing phase
textPreview: Specialized agents for each testing phase

text: Standard pentest methodology is divided among specialized agents.
textPreview: Standard pentest methodology is divided among specialized agents.

text: Maps the attack surface using discovery, DNS, probing and service-enumeration tools.
textPreview: Maps the attack surface using discovery, DNS, probing and service-enumeration tools.

text: Tests the mapped surface with network, web and vulnerability-analysis tools.
textPreview: Tests the mapped surface with network, web and vulnerability-analysis tools.

text: Confirms evidence and separates reproducible findings from scanner leads.
textPreview: Confirms evidence and separates reproducible findings from scanner leads.

text: Each agent has its own tools and skill files, but all agents operate on the same shared memory.
textPreview: Each agent has its own tools and skill files, but all agents operate on the same shared memory.

alt: Reconnaissance, vulnerability and validation phase agents

text: The phase agents follow the standard pentesting methodology. Reconnaissance maps the surface, vulnerability assessment tests it, and validation confirms evidence before reporting. Each agent has appropriate tools and skills, while shared memory prevents the phases from becoming disconnected.
The battle-tested pentesting methodology runs through repeatable rules and tools without requiring an LLM.
textPreview: The battle-tested pentesting methodology runs through repeatable rules and tools without requiring an LLM.

text: The LLM oversees the assessment, performs contextual analysis and decides where deeper reasoning is useful.
textPreview: The LLM oversees the assessment, performs contextual analysis and decides where deeper reasoning is useful.

text: Skill files form the knowledge base for tools, techniques and phase-specific procedures.
textPreview: Skill files form the knowledge base for tools, techniques and phase-specific procedures.

alt: Reasoning loop and deterministic pipeline using the same skill files

text: Two execution paths use the same skills and evidence. The deterministic pipeline performs repeatable, battle-tested steps without an LLM. The LLM oversees the wider context and adds judgment where uncertainty or adaptive reasoning matters. Skill files provide the extensible knowledge base.
Comparable operation with and without an LLM.

textPreview: Zero scope violations and measurable time improvement.

text: Present this as the planned schedule. The final evaluation will compare coverage, reliability across both modes, safety controls and time efficiency against manual baselines.
